bug_semantics: LocalFolderExtractor canonicalized each attacker-controlled RAR entry path, but createDirectory() and createFile() decided containment with String.startsWith(destinationCanonicalPath). That compares lexical prefixes rather than path-component boundaries. For destination /tmp/extract, an entry ../extract_evil/pwned.txt canonicalizes to /tmp/extract_evil/pwned.txt, which still starts with /tmp/extract, so extraction proceeds and writes attacker-controlled content into the sibling directory. Both file and directory entry paths used the same defective check.
flaw_origin: Incomplete path-traversal remediation in e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a (2019-01-27, lucass, `Test first: "fix throw Exception"`). That commit first added canonical-path containment guards to both createDirectory() and createFile(), but used boundary-insensitive getCanonicalPath().startsWith(destination.getCanonicalPath()). Its parent f3097eb950c9531b0013a9657469d1b102ea72e4 had no containment guard at either sink and was already generically traversal-prone; e60b915 is nevertheless the smallest first-writer of the advisory's specifically defective string-prefix validation. b2abb7078fe2398067424275553d5b28cf571c96 only reformatted/re-expressed those guards and is not the BIC, while 947ff1d33f00f940aa68ae2593500291d799d954 later normalized separators without curing the sibling-prefix comparison.
ai_marker: BIC commit-object inspection (`git cat-file commit e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a`) shows author and committer `lucass <lucass@gmail.com>` at Unix time 1548544511 +0100 and message `Test first: "fix throw Exception"`. It has no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, AI-tool, or bot trailer/identity; it is a normal one-parent human commit from 2019. No qualifying BIC commit-object AI signal is present.
evidence: Advisory bundle GHSA-hf5p-q87m-crj7 / CVE-2026-41245 names LocalFolderExtractor's string-prefix validation, gives the concrete `/tmp/extract` plus `../extract_evil/file.txt` sibling-write attack, declares Maven com.github.junrar:junrar versions `< 7.5.10` affected and 7.5.10 first patched, and directly references d77e9a83eb721cd51f9c23d7869d0e6ad7f952d7. In the validated clone, `git show d77e9a83eb721cd51f9c23d7869d0e6ad7f952d7 -- src/main/java/com/github/junrar/LocalFolderExtractor.java` replaces both `startsWith(destinationCanonicalPath)` checks with `startsWith(destinationCanonicalPath + File.separator)` and adds the sibling-prefix regression archive/test. `git log --all --reverse -S'getCanonicalPath().startsWith' -- src/main/java/com/github/junrar/LocalFolderExtractor.java` identifies e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a as the first addition; `git show e60b915...` displays both flawed guards. `git show e60b915^:src/main/java/com/github/junrar/LocalFolderExtractor.java` directly verifies parent f3097eb950c9531b0013a9657469d1b102ea72e4 has neither guard. `git log -L 34,35:src/main/java/com/github/junrar/LocalFolderExtractor.java a60857b35c17dbd5354a37816421d7b051a8ba03` and the corresponding `-L 60,61` trace both later spellings through formatting commit b2abb7078fe2398067424275553d5b28cf571c96 back to e60b915, preventing blame from misclassifying the formatter as BIC. `git rev-list --parents -n 1 e60b915...` yields exactly parent f3097eb..., so this is not a merge/squash aggregate. For the release boundary, `git rev-parse v7.5.9^{}` gives 7e1b5581f9d622b96e9e2a8574188027e7642634 and `git merge-base --is-ancestor d77e9a83... v7.5.9^{}` fails; `git rev-parse v7.5.10^{}` gives e36ee091ad7311a021e1c928ada103a3eab2d890 and the same ancestor check succeeds. `git tag --contains d77e9a83... --sort=version:refname` begins at v7.5.10. `git cat-file commit e60b915...` reproduces the marker-absence and identity check.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the component-boundary error in an attempted canonical-path containment check, not canonicalization itself. e60b915 is the minimal causal first-writer of that exact residual bypass: its parent had unrestricted traversal but did not contain the flawed prefix-validation lines, and later b2abb707 only reformatted them. The direct advisory fix adds the missing separator boundary at both sinks and lands between v7.5.9 and v7.5.10, matching the advisory's `<7.5.10` range. Because the only permissible AI evidence is the BIC commit object and that object is an ordinary 2019 human commit with no AI attribution or bot identity, the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
